scope: WP6 final: read model, incremental frames, thread stream with frame-cursor reconnect, run stream

roadmapExitCriteria.E1_state_no_task_reads: pass — 100 jobs / 10 chats fixture: GET /v1/state performs 0 storage.task and 0 scanTasks calls
roadmapExitCriteria.E2_single_commit_O_change: pass — one-job amend = 1 patch op, frame count independent of total job count, delta << full snapshot
roadmapExitCriteria.E3_reconnect_consistency: pass — in-window replay converges state+messages; frame-granular resume; window_exceeded/unknown_seq/process_restarted resync with no faked continuity

defectsFoundAndFixedByVerification: derived v2 index updates were silently dropped: tx.doc(family,key,seed) ignores the seed for an existing document, so point.chats/point.jobs/point.resources/point.requests stayed at their creation value (stale /v1/state and stale STATE_DELTA). Fixed by mutating the returned draft in runtime/state-index.ts.
in-window reconnect opened a new sync run/snapshot, violating the frozen binding contract; now replays only the frames after the cursor
rollback guard discarded the remaining frames of the commit a client was cut inside; guard now only drops frames strictly older than the last snapshot actually sent
messages snapshots were filtered out of in-window replay, so reconnected clients kept stale history
testCostChanges: retention overflow test now injects a 32-frame window instead of issuing 6,000 real commits (assertions unchanged)
one assertion counted rows with array semantics; updated to the frozen id-keyed shape via the shared familyArray helper
unverified: real SSE long connections / reverse proxy buffering / half-open / EPIPE
slow consumer behaviour and the 64 concurrent stream cap under load
process restart resync end-to-end over HTTP beyond the in-suite restart case
full tool-history messages snapshot (deferred to a later WP)
